question: The IBC gate's question under v2.1's faster settings: on the two-frame history state, can IBC behavioral cloning recover at least half of the coverage gap between holding still and the demonstrator, trained to a 50,000-step ceiling with checkpoints every 5,000, compiled, in bf16 mixed precision?

dataset.derivation: tools/pusht_v2/derive.py: x_bar_t = [x_{t-1}, x_t] for observation.state (2 -> 4) and observation.environment_state (16 -> 32); each episode's first frame dropped

split.source: the pilot's CCIL split (docs/studies/evidence/pusht-m1-pilot/run/labels.json); BC trains on the other 165 episodes

lerobot.plugins: tools/pusht_v2/env_plugin (lerobot_env_pusht_history 1.0.0) and tools/pusht_v2/ibc_plugin (lerobot_policy_ibc 1.1.0), installed from the gate's commit

policy.reference: real-stanford/diffusion_policy 5ba07ac: train_ibc_dfo_lowdim_workspace.yaml with task pusht_lowdim; policy/ibc_dfo_lowdim_policy.py (andy_train false, kevin_inference false)
policy.other: min/max normalization to [-1, 1] of STATE, ENV and ACTION; AdamW betas (0.95, 0.999); cosine to 0 at the last step; no gradient clipping; bf16 autocast over float32 weights (Accelerate mixed precision); the energy network compiled in training

training.budget: the IBC gate's held-out InfoNCE selection picked its first checkpoint (20k of 200k) on every seed and rose at every later one; 50k with checkpoints every 5k covers that region more finely. compile + bf16 measured 2.21x faster per step (evidence/pusht-v2/development/speed)

selection.rule: the saved checkpoint with the lowest mean held-out InfoNCE (select_infonce.py: every frame of the held-out episodes of the derived dataset, eval mode, 1024 uniform negatives drawn once from seed 0 and shared by every checkpoint); ties go to the earlier checkpoint; simulator returns are never used

evaluation.note: the pilot's evaluation through the plugin env, which carries the previous observation (the reset frame repeated at a reset, which is at rest)

gate.statistic: the mean over the three seeds of avg_max_reward at each seed's selected checkpoint
gate.rule: pass iff (statistic - hold) / (demonstration_replay - hold) >= 0.5. Pass: freeze v2 and run bc, duplication and ccil with this learner and state. Fail: no CCIL run
